svg.title: Jiangxi Provincial Government Scholarship, awarded twice. In my second and third years I sat a competitive exam open to all international students at my university. I was one of the two students selected. Each award was RMB 20,000, RMB 40,000 in total. Timeline: 2011, Golden A+; 2013, GPA 5.00 of 5.00; Year 2, Provincial scholarship; Year 3, Provincial scholarship, again; 2017, BEng completed.
